stories.deck: AP, UN/BINUH and local reporting describe operations and violence in different parts of the country; the accounts are not merged into a single measure of success.

sources.supports: Reported operations and security developments; use attributed language.
sources.limits: Does not establish a complete national operational picture or prove territorial control.

stories.title: ECLAC records at least 3,386 femicides across 27 countries and territories
stories.deck: The regional observatory’s official 2025 measure separates recorded femicides from attempted or frustrated cases and does not support the conflicting 24-per-day claim.

sources.supports: Official 2025 regional measure: at least 3,386 femicides across 27 countries and territories; attempted or frustrated cases are reported separately for 10 countries.
sources.limits: Country coverage and definitions vary; the measure is not a complete count of all gender-based violence.

claims.text: At least 3,386 femicides were recorded across 27 Latin American and Caribbean countries and territories in 2025.
Attempted or frustrated cases are kept as a separate measure for 10 countries.
The conflicting 24-per-day claim is excluded from this story.

stories.title: Canary Islands declares emergency as maritime arrivals strain El Hierro
stories.deck: The Canary Islands government declared a health, social and security emergency on El Hierro; reporting describes maritime arrivals without assigning nationality, intent or legal status.

sources.supports: Official emergency declaration and its stated health, social and security scope.
sources.limits: The declaration does not by itself establish the identity, intent or legal status of people arriving by sea.

sources.supports: Independent reporting on the arrival context and response.
sources.limits: Use neutral migration language and preserve attribution for reported details.

claims.text: The Canary Islands government declared a health, social and security emergency on El Hierro.
The story concerns maritime arrivals and the island response.
Nationality, intent, criminality and legal status are not inferred.
